explanation: The lower cone z=√(x²+y²)-2 has outward vector area element ⟨x/√(x²+y²),y/√(x²+y²),-1⟩ dA. Its flux integrand is xy/√(x²+y²)-2x. The upper disk has outward normal ⟨0,0,1⟩ and contributes 2x. Their sum is xy/√(x²+y²), giving d. All displayed integrands integrate to zero over the symmetric disk, but d directly combines the two surface contributions. The undefined value at the origin does not affect the integral.
